description: The retrieval declaration (S22 T7, V7/R6): `contextRetrievals` declares — it does not resolve. Each {corpus, query} is NAMED (O8, no defaults); the daemon resolves it ONCE at Compile, freezes the hits' files into the manifest marked `retrieved` with query and score (V14/O2), and no resume or recovery re-asks (N7). Nothing-found is RECORDED in the manifest, not silenced (O6). Absent the key, retrieval was never asked — a different state from asking and finding nothing.
